svg.title: Valkey black hole
svg.desc: A relativistic accretion disk seen almost edge on: a dark circular shadow ringed by a thin bright photon ring, the disk lensed up over the top of the shadow and crossing in front of it below, blazing white on the left where the orbiting gas comes towards the viewer and fading to dim red on the right where it recedes, the white Valkey hexagon mark at the centre. The title "Valkey black hole" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
